verdict.rationale: The README explicitly states Apple silicon is a first-class citizen, optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal frameworks. Hands-on reports from M1/M1 Max users (about 56–83 ms/token on 7B; 63 t/s generation with gemma-3-4b) corroborate fast inference on Apple Silicon. The remark about not using Apple's neural engine refers to the ANE, not Metal, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party Metal/ARM documentation beyond a one-line README bullet, and benchmarks that explicitly attribute the speedups to the Metal backend.
